title: On Differing from the older account
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：differ　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 differ 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the warden ① differed from the older account in the rain, and every resident in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the warden ② differs from the older account without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ differ from the older account at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ differed from the older account before — a line in the register for June 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Differing from the older account in the rain, the warden said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ differ about the cost of the work without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Differ about the cost of the work at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new resident from the next centre ⑧ differs about the cost of the work in the rain every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ differed from the older account again when nobody else would.

⑩ To differ from the older account, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the centre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the centre forgets, somebody differs from the older account without complaint again and somebody must differ from the older account in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 相异（一般过去式 differed from the older account：1976 年管理员头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 相异（一般现在 differs from the older account：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 相异（不定式 to differ from the older account：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 相异（过去完成时 had differed from the older account：1970 年六月的登记册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 相异（动名词 differing from the older account 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 持异议（differ about the cost of the work：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去持异议在这笔花销上意见不一）
G. v. 持异议（differ about the cost of the work：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 相异（后段两处：新来的居民照例 differs about the cost of the work，而母亲又一次 differed from the older account）

items.q: to differ from the older account
differed from the older account before
differ about the cost of the work without complaint
differ about the cost of the work at once
differs about the cost of the work in the rain
differed from the older account again
to differ from the older account

answers.why: differ 意为“相异”，1976 年管理员淋着雨相异与更早的那份记载不同，那是社区中心里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 differed。
differ 意为“相异”，自那以后管理员毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 differs。
differ 意为“相异”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯相异与更早的那份记载不同”，此处为不定式 to differ from the older account。
differ 意为“相异”，登记册里 六月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人相异过，故用过去完成时 had differed。
differ 意为“相异”，管理员说“相异与更早的那份记载不同这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 differing from the older account 作主语。
differ 意为“持异议”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去持异议在这笔花销上意见不一”，should ever 之后用原形 differ about the cost of the work。
differ 意为“持异议”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻持异议在这笔花销上意见不一（differ about the cost of the work at once），以后再也不要提起。
differ 意为“相异”，新来的居民每个月份都照例持异议在这笔花销上意见不一，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 differs。
differ 意为“相异”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨相异与更早的那份记载不同，用一般过去式 differed 叙述。
differ 意为“相异”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要相异与更早的那份记载不同，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和社区中心记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，管理员淋着雨相异与更早的那份记载不同；社区中心里每一个居民都说这是头一回。（differed from the older account）
多年以后，管理员仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（differs from the older account）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯相异与更早的那份记载不同这件事本身。（to differ from the older account）
早在 1970 年就有人相异与更早的那份记载不同，六月那天登记册上的一行字就是证据。（had differed from the older account）
管理员说过，淋着雨相异与更早的那份记载不同这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（differing from the older account 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻持异议在这笔花销上意见不一，以后再也不要提起。（differ about the cost of the work，祈使句）
answers: In 1976 the warden differed from the older account in the rain, and every resident in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the warden still differs from the older account without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to differ from the older account at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had differed from the older account long before 1983, and the line in the register for June proves it.
Differing from the older account in the rain, the warden said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Differ about the cost of the work at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 differ 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the warden differed from the older account in the rain, and nobody in the centre forgot it.
Even now the warden differs from the older account without complaint whenever the centre asks.
Differing from the older account in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever differ about the cost of the work without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new resident from the next centre differs about the cost of the work in the rain every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother differed from the older account again, and the centre remembered that half.
